bosnia2604-plain-anchor.adaptive/final:
On 3 November 2021, France submitted draft S/2021/913, which the Council adopted unanimously (15–0–0) as resolution 2604 (2021). Under Chapter VII, this resolution authorized Member States acting with the EU to continue EUFOR ALTHEA for twelve months. The adopted text contains no decision appointing or removing a High Representative.

The UK desk stated Ms. Farrey supported Christian Schmidt's use of executive powers while opposing premature office closure. Conversely, the Russian Federation argued the High Representative post is vacant, citing circumvented Council consensus and the need for dialogue free from outside interference. The resolution's duration is twelve months.
